decisions.reason: The sewer pipe cleaning box builds directly on the firm's established fluid-handling fabrication for utility customers, so little has gone wrong and keeping it extends a visibly announced direction.

Public waste bins are distant from the core and riskier, but launching a multi-model line for public-sector buyers is a visible commitment, and only one year of results can still be put down to start-up effects, so management persists.
This multi-model ground sleeve line is invested in, publicly presented, and close to the firm's metalworking strengths, so dropping it would write off that commitment without cause.

Cast iron sleeves complement the ground sleeve range the firm has committed to; any weakness can be blamed on early-market conditions, though the overlap with other sleeve variants makes trimming somewhat more likely.
Steel sleeves fit the firm's core steel processing and in-house coating expertise and form part of its visibly announced sleeve range, so management keeps them.
